check: DROP TABLE or destructive migration without backup
fix: Confirm backup exists; add comment with recovery plan

check: Optional dependency on auth function; unauthenticated access to sensitive data
fix: Make dependency non-optional: user: User = Depends(require_user)

check: API key / password / token hardcoded in source
fix: Move to env var via pydantic Settings; rotate compromised key

check: f-string or % format in SQL query
example_violation: sql = f"SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = {user_input}"
fix: Use parameterized queries: execute(text('SELECT * WHERE id = :id'), {'id': id})

check: PEM key, recovery codes, .env committed
fix: Move out of repo immediately; rotate all compromised credentials

check: Model field added/changed without corresponding Alembic migration
example_violation: New column in ORM model but no migration file
fix: Run alembic revision --autogenerate; review and commit migration

check: downgrade() not implemented in migration
fix: Implement reverse of upgrade() operations

check: ORM relationship loaded inside loop without eager load
example_violation: for item in items: print(item.user.name)  # N queries
fix: Use selectinload or joinedload on the initial query

check: New feature added without test coverage
example_violation: New endpoint in router with no test file
fix: Add integration test covering happy path and auth check

check: Bug fixed but no regression test added
example_violation: Fix applied with no test that would have caught original bug
fix: Add test that fails without the fix

check: Blocking call in async function
fix: Use asyncio.sleep(); httpx.AsyncClient; run_in_executor for CPU-bound

check: List endpoint returns all rows without pagination
fix: Add page/page_size params; return Page[ItemOut]

check: Mutable default in function signature
fix: Use None as default: def f(items=None): items = items or []

check: float used for monetary values
fix: Use Decimal: from decimal import Decimal; price: Decimal

check: Unsanitized user content in dangerouslySetInnerHTML
fix: Sanitize with DOMPurify or avoid entirely

check: Missing dependency in useEffect deps array
fix: Add value to deps: useEffect(() => { fn(value) }, [value])

check: CORS allows all origins in production
fix: List explicit allowed origins in production settings

check: Container running as root user
fix: Add: RUN useradd -m app; USER app

check: docker compose run without -T in CI/scripts
fix: docker compose run -T --rm app ./migrate.sh

check: No HEALTHCHECK in Dockerfile
fix: Add HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost/health

check: Shell variables unquoted in CI YAML
fix: - run: echo "$MY_VAR"
